findings.evidence: Grep finds `Module.Basis.forall_coord_eq_zero_iff]` at OrthogonalBasis.lean:539, Positivity.lean:342 and Positivity.lean:355, each preceded by the same `Finset.prod_pos` lambda.
findings.fix: Factor out one lemma, e.g. `(∀ s, ∏ i ∈ s, w i ≠ 0 → (basis …).repr x s = 0) ↔ x = 0` given `∀ i, w i ≠ 0` (or a plain Basis-level version), and use it in all three proofs.
findings.issue: The faithfulness proofs end with the same `simp only [fun s ↦ (Finset.prod_pos (s := s) …).ne', ne_eq, not_false_eq_true, forall_const, ← Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.forall_coord_eq_zero_iff]` step in three places: here, at Positivity.lean:355, and in the rewritten `scalarTrace_reverse_mul_self_eq_zero_iff` at OrthogonalBasis.lean:539.

findings.evidence: Both proofs are `rw [_, Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.sum, Complex.ofReal_sum]; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_; rw [Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]; ring` (Positivity.lean:190-194 and :202-206).
findings.fix: State the conj-to-normSq step once for any real weight family `w`: `(f.sum fun s z ↦ conj z * ((w s : ℂ) * f s)) = ((f.sum fun s z ↦ normSq z * w s : ℝ) : ℂ)`, together with its nonneg and zero-set corollaries. Derive both sign variants from it.
findings.issue: The negative-metric norm-square, nonnegativity and zero-set lemmas repeat the positive-form proofs line for line with the weight `Q (b i)` swapped for `-Q (b i)`. `scalarTrace_conjStar_mul_self` (line 205) has the same body as `scalarTrace_complexConj_reverse_mul_self` (line 193), and the `_nonneg_of_isOrtho` and `_eq_zero_iff_basis_repr_eq_zero` pairs repeat the same way.

findings.evidence: The `rw [...]` block at OrthogonalBasis.lean:140-141 rewrites only by unfolding plus one substantive lemma (`involute_basis`).
findings.fix: Replace the chain with `simp [involute_basis hb, Finsupp.single_apply]` or an equivalent single simp call.
findings.issue: `basis_repr_involute` closes its goal with a seven-step chain of named rewrites (`LinearMap.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, involute_basis hb, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self`), which is fragile against Mathlib renames.

summary: The proofs are robust and contain no undocumented definitional-equality tricks, but the same closing argument is copied in three places and every positive-form/negative-metric result is proved twice instead of once from a weight-generic lemma.
